title: 6 Ordinary Moments Where a Godly Man Chooses Obedience Over Impulse
caption:
6 ordinary moments where a godly man chooses obedience over impulse. None of them happen on a mountaintop.

The snooze button. The midnight reply. The second plate. The tab he almost opens. The comeback he lets go. The hour he could waste.

None of these make the highlight reel. All of them decide who's actually running your life.

#selfcontrol #godlyman #christianmen #discipline #biblicalmanhood
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
